description: The plot illustrates the performance of five different methods—TrajICL, Head Tuning, FT, LoRA 16, and LoRA 64—measured by minFDE$_{20}$ ($\downarrow$) across varying ratios. The x-axis is labeled "Ratio" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately 0.1 to 1.0, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "minFDE$_{20}$ ($\downarrow$)" and uses a linear scale with visible numeric tick labels at 0.8, 0.9, 1.1, 1.2, and 1.3, representing an interval of 0.1, with the data spanning a range from roughly 0.76 to 1.32. The "TrajICL" line is a solid blue line with circular markers; it starts at approximately 0.90 at an x-value of 0.1, remains relatively stable with minor fluctuations, and ends at roughly 0.85 at an x-value of 1.0. The "Head Tuning" line is a solid orange line with circular markers; it begins at the highest value of approximately 1.32 at x=0.1, declines steadily to about 1.06 at x=0.9, and ends with a slight increase to roughly 1.07 at x=1.0. The "FT" line is a solid green line with circular markers; it starts at approximately 1.09 at x=0.1 and exhibits a continuous decline, ending at the lowest overall value of approximately 0.76 at x=1.0. The "LoRA 16" line is a solid red line with circular markers; it begins at approximately 1.22 at x=0.1, decreases to roughly 0.94 at x=0.7, remains flat until x=0.9, and ends at approximately 0.93 at x=1.0. Finally, the "LoRA 64" line is a solid purple line with circular markers; it starts at approximately 1.22 at x=0.1, closely tracking the LoRA 16 line initially, and steadily declines to end at approximately 0.93 at x=1.0.
